terms: Professional commercial driver included in every rental package.
Tolls, state entry permits, and parking fees are charged on actuals.
Fixed Day Package covers up to 12 hours and 250 KM from garage to garage.
Extra distance beyond 250 KM is billed at ₹26 per kilometer.
Night halt allowance (₹700) applies for journeys crossing 11:00 PM.
Air-conditioned coaches maintain optimal cooling throughout the route.
Luggage space is complimentary up to vehicle specified capacity.
notes: Prices shown on the website are estimated quotes for standard planning. Final quotation is confirmed upon route review and date availability.
